description: This file provides utility classes for handling files in the Subtitle Sync Platform backend. It includes functionalities for validating, saving, moving, and retrieving information about files, especially focusing on video and subtitle files. The code ensures files meet size, extension, and content validation criteria, and manages file storage and cleanup operations.

classes.name: FileValidator
classes.description: Provides static methods for validating file size, extension, and content, with specific validation logic for video and subtitle files.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Manages file storage operations including saving uploads, moving files to processed directories, creating temporary copies, cleaning up temp files, and retrieving file info.

methods.name: bool validate_file_size(file_size: int)
methods.description: Checks if a file's size is within configured limits.

methods.name: bool validate_file_extension(filename: str, file_type: str)
methods.description: Checks if a filename's extension is allowed for specified file types ('video' or 'subtitle').

methods.name: Dict[str,any] validate_file_content(file_path: str, expected_type: str)
methods.description: Analyzes file content and MIME type to validate if it matches expected file type.

methods.name: bool _validate_subtitle_content(file_path: str)
methods.description: Performs content-based validation for subtitle files by matching common subtitle patterns.

methods.name: Dict[str,any] save_uploaded_file(self, file_obj: BinaryIO, filename: str, file_type: str)
methods.description: Saves an uploaded file after validation and returns details or errors.

methods.name: str move_to_processed(self, source_path: str, new_filename: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Moves a file from the upload directory to the processed directory, handling filename conflicts.

methods.name: str create_temp_copy(self, source_path: str)
methods.description: Creates a temporary copy of a file for processing.

methods.name: cleanup_temp_files(self, max_age_hours: int = 24)
methods.description: Removes temporary files older than a specified age.

methods.name: Dict[str,any] get_file_info(self, file_path: str)
methods.description: Gathers comprehensive metadata about a file such as size, timestamps, MIME type, and checksum.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,any]] list_files(self, directory: str, pattern: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists files in a specified directory, optionally filtered by pattern.

methods.name: str _generate_safe_filename(self, filename: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes and appends timestamp to filenames to prevent conflicts and issues.

methods.name: str _calculate_file_checksum(self, file_path: str)
methods.description: Calculates MD5 checksum for integrity verification.
